mapper.update: update track_stat set stat_num= stat_num+#{num} where track_id=#{trackId} and stat_type=#{type}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(IF(track_stat.stat_type='0701',track_stat.stat_num,0)) as playStatNum, MAX(IF(track_stat.stat_type='0702',track_stat.stat_num,0)) as collectStatNum, MAX(IF(track_stat.stat_type='0703',track_stat.stat_num,0)) as praiseStatNum, MAX(IF(track_stat.stat_type='0704',track_stat.stat_num,0)) as commentStatNum FROM track_stat WHERE track_id=#{trackId} GROUP BY track_stat.track_id
